tasks.CheckCoprime: Verify if gcd(a, b) divides n.
tasks.FindGCD: Calculate the greatest common divisor of a and b to check if they are coprime.
tasks.FindSolution: If gcd(a, b) divides n, find x and y that satisfy ax + by = n using extended Euclidean algorithm.
tasks.HandleNoSolution: Return 'No solution' if gcd(a, b) does not divide n.
